assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未发布官方总体边界与重点区域 polygon，本方案全部几何为 provisional 临时粗略约束，仅用于内容设计与机器校验；官方图形发布后必须整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry here is provisional and must be recomputed when official data arrives.

assumptions.statement_zh: 轨道与街道控制条件及控规指标未知，本方案不给出任何具体数值结论，仅保留概念口径的示意。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory control conditions are unknown; this proposal keeps concept-level indications only.

assumptions.statement_zh: 科技服务、投融资与人才服务相关数据仅作概念性匿名聚合引用，不替代官方统计，不涉及任何真实个体信息。
assumptions.statement_en: Service-flow data are concept-level anonymized references only, not official statistics.

assumptions.statement_zh: 知转驿站、金链驿台与慧才驿栈设施均为原创概念建议，模块化可逆，不构成建设承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: All node facilities are original reversible conceptual proposals, not construction commitments.

assumptions.statement_zh: AI助手与数据流通服务仅提供匿名聚合与人工复核兜底，不设个体识别采集，不设无法人工终止的自动决定。
assumptions.statement_en: AI assistants process anonymized aggregates only, with human review as backstop.

assumptions.statement_zh: 成果转化路演日、技术交易集市与分期实施等均为建议性设计，不代表已确定的政府安排或投资承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: The event system and phasing are design suggestions, not confirmed government or investment commitments.
